about.intro: Calculeat is a nutrition app that combines science-based calculators with simple food logging — all in one place.

whatIs.body: Calculeat helps you calculate your calorie needs (TDEE), plan macronutrients, log food and track your body composition. We focus on precision and scientific foundation — not on simplifications that can lead you astray.

methodology.calculatorsBody: All calculators are based on published research. The TDEE calculator uses Mifflin-St Jeor for BMR (validated in independent studies as the most accurate for the general population) and five PAL levels (1.2–1.9) for activity factor. We also offer 9 alternative BMR formulas for different populations.
methodology.databaseBody: Food data is sourced from the Swedish National Food Database (Livsmedelsverket), USDA FoodData Central and user-submitted foods. We verify contributed data via a community system.
methodology.contentBody: All articles and explanations are reviewed against published research (PubMed, WHO, ACSM, EFSA). We include source references so you can review the evidence yourself.

limitations.body1: Calculators provide estimates — not diagnoses. TDEE formulas have a margin of error of approximately ±10–15%. Individual factors such as muscle mass, hormonal balance and metabolism affect the real value. Always use the results as a starting point and adjust based on actual outcomes.
limitations.body2: Calculeat is not a medical tool and does not replace advice from a dietitian or doctor. For illness, eating disorders or special medical needs — always consult healthcare professionals.

contact.body: Feedback, bug reports and questions are welcome via email at info.calculeat@gmail.com — we'll reply as soon as we can.

seo.title: Terms of Service | Calculeat
seo.description: Calculeat terms of service — account, Premium subscription, payment, right of withdrawal, and limitations of liability.

terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Calculeat. By creating an account you accept the terms.

sections.body: Calculeat is a nutrition app for food logging, calorie calculation, and body composition, provided via calculeat.com. Contact us via email at info.calculeat@gmail.com.
You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secret and for activity on your account. An account is personal and may not be shared.

Calculeat's core features are free. Premium is a subscription costing 45 SEK per month or 399 SEK per year, VAT included, with a 7-day free trial. Current prices and what each tier includes are always shown at calculeat.com/premium. Price changes are announced at least 30 days in advance and apply from the next renewal at the earliest.

Payments are handled by Stripe. We never store your card details. The subscription renews automatically until cancelled. You can cancel at any time via Manage subscription in the app settings — the subscription then continues to the end of the period you have already paid for, with no further charges.

You have a 14-day right of withdrawal under Swedish distance contract law. Since the trial period is 7 days, you are charged nothing if you cancel before it ends. If a payment has been made within the withdrawal period, we refund it if you contact us via email at info.calculeat@gmail.com.

Your data is never deleted because of your tier. If you go from Premium to the free tier, content above the free limits becomes readable but locked — nothing disappears. If you delete your account, all your data is permanently deleted.

You may not abuse the service, attempt to circumvent technical restrictions, disrupt operations, or use the service in ways that harm other users. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.

Calculeat's calculators and computations are estimates and do not constitute medical advice. In case of illness, eating disorders, or special medical needs, always consult healthcare professionals. The service is provided as is. To the extent permitted by mandatory consumer law, our liability is limited to what you have paid for the service in the last twelve months. Your statutory consumer rights are never affected by these terms.
Material changes are announced in the app or by email at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use after that constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

Swedish law applies. In case of a dispute you can turn to the Swedish National Board for Consumer Disputes (ARN) or the EU online dispute resolution platform. Questions are answered via email at info.calculeat@gmail.com.

seo.title: Privacy Policy | Calculeat
seo.description: How Calculeat processes your personal data — what we collect, why, who receives it, and your rights under the GDPR.

privacy.intro: Calculeat processes your personal data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Here we explain what we collect, why, and what rights you have.

sections.body: Calculeat is the data controller for the processing described here. Contact us via email at info.calculeat@gmail.com.

Account data: email address and username. Health-related data you enter yourself: weight, height, sex, date of birth, body measurements, food and weight logs. Payments: handled entirely by Stripe — we never see your card details, only subscription status. Technical information required for login and security.

We process your data to deliver the service (contract, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Health-related data is processed with your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a)) — you give it by entering the data yourself, and you can withdraw it at any time by deleting the data or your account. Security and abuse protection is based on legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)), and bookkeeping of payments on legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).

We use data processors to run the service: Supabase (database and authentication), Stripe (payments), Vercel (hosting), and Google (AI reading of nutrition label photos when you use label scanning — the image is sent to Google's Gemini service for interpretation and is not stored by us). GDPR data processing agreements are in place with all of them. For transfers outside the EU/EEA, the European Commission's standard contractual clauses are used.

Your data is kept as long as your account exists. If you delete your account, all your personal data is permanently deleted. Payment records are kept for seven years under the Swedish Bookkeeping Act.

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability, and to object to processing. You can get a free export of all your data by contacting us via email at info.calculeat@gmail.com. You can also lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (imy.se).
Calculeat only uses necessary local storage in your browser for login and settings. We use no advertising cookies and no third-party tracking.
Changes to this policy are announced in the app. For material changes concerning health data, we ask for renewed consent.
